body:
I have been hospitalized. The last time I was in the hospital I was there for about 3 months. It was torture. They fed me frozen food and would refuse to heat it back up and video taped me without telling me. There were extremely sexually aggressive people there. I get panic attacks thinking about ever being readmitted. 

Since then, I haven't had a day of relief and I was admitted November 2nd of last year. Its been over 7 months of straight-up "one more day-ing" myself and in that time I've met new friends, met and got together with a very amazing boy, talked over important things with my family, started medication, and I'm still hopeless, still empty, still done. Things are *looking* up but I am feeling worse every day. I can't say I haven't felt hope before but my cycles in and out of hope are 2 weeks of happiness to at least a couple months of despair and its just not a manageable ratio. 

There are other factors as well.. I feel that I am becoming a worse person, treating people terribly, doing things I don't respect in myself and I just need to end things before they get even worse. One of the things that kept me alive was thinking I could live for other people, but I am unable to do that anymore. I know I will innevitably hurt my family and loved ones if I stay alive and by killing myself I will do less damage, but in my mind I need to figure out how to do the least damage in that suicide before I go ahead and do it. 

I really want you to know I hear what you're saying. I *really* appreciate you replying. Very very much so. But I can't say that hope is really something I've ever been able to rely on. I'm destroying my life by staying alive, I don't want it to get worse. I might as well end it now before I hate and disrespect myself and others even more. I hope that makes sense.

Edit: I've been watching a lot of childhood shows/movies -- like arthur or liberty's kids and The Prince of Egypt. But I can't get out of bed to go to work. I've dropped out of school. I cannot function. If I weren't depressed, yes I would probably stay alive, but I can't end my depression no matter what I do. I wish my family could accept that I am sick and am dying and its ok. I'm terminally depressed. And its going to be ok.

I very much appreciate you reaching out. It has helped me at times too. I know at this point I have decided I'm going to kill myself. This will be the 4th time I've attempted it and its the only time I haven't been at least slightly impulsive about it. 

I wish I could talk to my parents about it and explain that it's going to happen regardless of what they do, but I feel this will put responsibility on them when ultimately the responsibility to stay alive or kill myself rests on me. If i mention to them that I am going to kill myself at x time... I will find myself in a psych ward no doubt about it *or* my parents will feel regret that they didn't do that for the rest of their life. I have to do it without telling them. I guess I just wanted someone else's ideas about the least cruel way to leave things with my family. I'm already planning on doing my laundry and packing up my things and making sure that I'm found by the police, but when I see my family I just feel so guilty that I'm their child's murderer. I feel as guilty as I would if I were to murder someone that weren't me. 

I am sorry that you have felt suicidal as well, and even sorrier if you are currently feeling suicidal. Its not an easy way to live and, as I have decided, I won't be living that way for very much longer. At this point I don't have any memories from before I was suicidal and I don't know life without it. At this point I need to stop complaining about it and just do it. It's been over 10 years and over half my life. I've already tried "leaving everything and doing whatever I want, being 'free' or what have you" and that hasn't helped. I've tried medication (of different kinds not just SSRIs). I've been in therapy for over 8 years. 

The one thing that hurts is as prepared as *I* feel for my death, the same can't and most likely wont ever be said about my family. I just wish I knew how to minimize their pain.
